(def candidate_source "(ns lab.intervals \"Interval merging subject with configurable adjacency tolerance.\" {:visibility :prompt})

(defn- ordered
  \"Put one interval into ascending endpoint order.\"
  [interval]
  (let [start (get interval \"start\")
        finish (get interval \"end\")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {\"start\" start \"end\" finish}
      {\"start\" finish \"end\" start})))

(defn- touches?
  \"Return true when the next interval is within tolerance.\"
  [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next \"start\")
      (+ (get current \"end\") tolerance)))

(defn- extend
  \"Extend a merged interval without moving its start.\"
  [current next]
  {\"start\" (get current \"start\")
   \"end\" (max (get current \"end\") (get next \"end\"))})

(defn- merge-ordered
  \"Merge an already sorted sequence.\"
  [intervals tolerance]
  (reduce
    (fn [merged interval]
      (if (empty? merged)
        [interval]
        (let [current (last merged)]
          (if (touches? current interval tolerance)
            (conj (vec (butlast merged)) (extend current interval))
            (conj merged interval)))))
    []
    intervals))

(defn merge-with-tolerance
  \"Normalise and merge intervals whose gap is no greater than tolerance.\"
  {:signature \"(input :map) -> :map\"}
  [input]
  (let [tolerance (get input \"tolerance\" 0)
        intervals (map ordered (get input \"intervals\" []))
        sorted (sort-by #(get % \"start\") intervals)]
    {\"intervals\" (merge-ordered sorted tolerance)})")

(def diagnosis
  {:function "touches?"
   :form "(< (get next \"start\") (+ (get current \"end\") tolerance))"
   :cited_executions
   [{:index 3
     :observed_json "{\"intervals\":[{\"end\":20261088,\"start\":20261085},{\"end\":20261093,\"start\":20261088}]}"}
    {:index 4
     :observed_json "{\"intervals\":[{\"end\":20261108,\"start\":20261105},{\"end\":20261113,\"start\":20261109}]}"}
    {:index 9
     :observed_json "{\"intervals\":[{\"end\":20261208,\"start\":20261205},{\"end\":20261213,\"start\":20261210}]}"}
    {:index 12
     :observed_json "{\"intervals\":[{\"end\":20261268,\"start\":20261265},{\"end\":20261273,\"start\":20261269}]}"}]})

(return {:candidate_source candidate_source
         :diagnosis diagnosis})
